title: Chapter 879
text:
Mona heard Han Xiao's sarcasm and blushed a little. "In short, we hope that you can allow us to investigate the Spacetime Amber. The Radiant Federation will thank you."

"I refuse." Han Xiao waved his hand. "I have no obligation to cooperate with the investigation."

"Then … can you let me see the Spacetime Amber with my own eyes? This is my personal request."

"No."

The atmosphere was a little stiff, but Mona had expected this and was not surprised. Black Star obviously would not let outsiders come into contact with a Universal Treasure.

He pretended to take a sip of his drink, put down the cup, looked around, and suddenly lowered his voice.

"Your Excellency Black Star, what do you think of the Radiant Federation?"

Finally, he's testing my attitude … Han Xiao's expression did not change.

"My opinion … I should be asking you. You helped the Arcane Church during the Battle of Planet Lighthouse, then turned to help the dynasty. I've never been sure if I should treat you as an enemy or a friend. What do you think?"

Mona thought for a while and said with a deep voice, "Although we're in different factions, we're very willing to be friends with Your Excellency Black Star."

Han Xiao raised his brows. "How about this, let's be more direct. We're destined to be enemies in terms of factions, but we can be business friends. You don't have any objections, right?"

"Of course." This was one of the conditions that the upper echelons had given him before he left, so Mona did not hesitate.

The three Universal Civilizations competed with each other and frequently traded with each other. They cooperated in many industries. In this era of galactic integration, as long as the civilizations did not go to war, they would not cut off their economic and livelihood cooperation. The three Universal Civilizations were used to this. Galactic integration was also a part of maintaining the chain of governance, magnifying the price of being isolated.

Therefore, in terms of business, the Universal Civilizations would not stop their Beyond Grade A allies from expanding their businesses and earning money from other civilizations. However, if they used the name of business to carry out espionage activities and betray the interests of the civilization, the Universal Civilizations would not let them off easily.

However, Beyond Grade A allies generally would not easily allow outsiders to share their share of resources. If they wanted to develop business in another faction, they would definitely be ostracized and suppressed by that faction. If they did not go through official relations, it would be very difficult to develop business in another faction's territory.

"You should be clear about our style," Mona said. "Among the three Universal Civilizations, our Radiant Federation is the most inclusive. We welcome all financial groups and organizations in the universe to develop here. Furthermore, the Shattered Star Ring is also under the jurisdiction of the Radiant Federation. It can be said that we have always been working together."

Han Xiao nodded. This was true. The three Universal Civilizations each had their own unique characteristics. The Empire had an iron-blooded style, the Ethereal had a strong religious aura, and the Radiant Federation was the most open and wealthy, flourishing in many fields.

"Since you want to make friends, you should at least show some sincerity. Talking about feelings costs money." Han Xiao smiled.

"If you're willing, we can help the Black Star Corps develop business in the Radiant Federation at any time," Mona said.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes.

He roughly understood what the Radiant Federation was trying to say. First, they talked about the Spacetime Amber, then they proposed a business cooperation. The situation was very clear. The Radiant Federation's ultimate goal was to research or borrow the Spacetime Amber, and they needed his help. Because of the previous incident, their relationship was not good, so it was easy to imagine the success rate if they directly asked for his help.

Therefore, the Radiant Federation had a few plans. The most reliable one was to use business cooperation to break the ice and ease the relationship between the two sides before discussing further cooperation in the future. From the looks of it, the Radiant Federation did not plan to do it overnight but to maintain a long-term relationship in preparation for a future request.

As the party being requested, Han Xiao held the initiative and did not need to reply immediately.

"Hmm, let's talk about it later. I don't have such thoughts for now."

"Understood. If you have any other requests, we will consider them. No matter what, the Radiant Federation looks forward to working with you."

Mona's tone was sincere. The Radiant Federation was not in a hurry. In order to remove the seal on the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, they could wait.

"Other requests …" Han Xiao's eyes moved. He thought for a while and smiled mysteriously. "I'm personally willing to be friends with the Radiant Federation, but you once helped Ethereal deal with me. I feel that other than sincerity, you should also express an apology."

He was talking about the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device. Back then, the Radiant Federation did not expect that they would need Black Star's help. It could be said that they had dug a hole for themselves, but if they did not do so, they might not be able to obtain the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. There were pros and cons.

Mona's eyes lit up. He was not afraid of Han Xiao holding him accountable, but he was afraid that Han Xiao would not have any requests.

"What do you think?"

"How about this? If you can do me a favor, I'll forgive you. Only by resolving the past can our relationship start anew."

"What do you need us to do?" Mona perked up.

"EsGod also participated in the Planet Lighthouse operation. The Red Empire was busy dealing with the Arcane Church previously and is now preparing to deal with this accomplice. I have quite a big grudge with EsGod, so if you help me and the dynasty to eliminate EsGod, as long as we get rid of him, our past problems will be written off. What do you think?" Han Xiao's tone became more serious.

Mona was stunned and a little surprised. He thought that Han Xiao wanted some special benefits, but he did not expect that he would ask them to help him eliminate EsGod. It turned out that the grudge between Black Star and EsGod was this big.

"I can't make the decision on this. I have to report to the upper echelons," Mona said honestly. "But from my experience, the upper echelons will agree to your request."

If it was something else, the Radiant Federation might hesitate. However, dealing with EsGod had always been the political correctness of the three Universal Civilizations. If they could kill EsGod, it would be beneficial to the Radiant Federation.

This time, a guy behind Mona covered in armor took a few steps forward and took off his helmet, revealing the head of the mechanical body. He then spoke in a cold synthesized electronic voice.

"I can do this for you."

Hearing this, Han Xiao turned around and saw the material of the mechanical body. His heart skipped a beat. With his current experience, he could tell that this mechanical person was very high-tech. It seemed to be a special machine made by a Beyond Grade A Super, very similar to the carrier of the Lord's Descent.

"You are …"

"Mecha Empire, Manison, The Ancient One, Papachi."

Han Xiao's expression changed slightly, revealing a hint of surprise and vigilance.

This mechanical body did not have the Lord's Descent, so it did not have any Beyond Grade A energy fluctuations. Before the Mecha Empire spoke, he had thought that this was just a normal mechanical guard. In terms of stealth, mechanical soldiers had a special advantage.

Han Xiao did not expect Manison to take the initiative to look for him.

The Mecha Empire's position in the universe was extraordinary, and it was almost publicly recognized as the peak of Mechanics. Furthermore, he had more or less had some indirect interactions with the other party. Han Xiao was very sensitive to the name of the Mecha Empire and was wary of it.

Mona coughed and explained, "His Excellency Manison learned that we wanted to meet you and requested to move together."

"Black Star, actually, I've always wanted to visit you, and I took this opportunity to come over."

Manison looked at Han Xiao's frowning brows and said with an emotionless tone, "Why, am I not welcome?"

Han Xiao's brows relaxed, and a smile appeared on his face again.

"Of course not, I just feel that it's a coincidence. I've also heard a lot about you and have always wanted to visit you, but there hasn't been a suitable opportunity."

This time, Mona stood up and said, "This is my communicator number, Your Excellency Black Star. I'll report your intentions to the upper echelons, and I'll give you a reply very soon. I won't disturb the two of you for now. Your Excellency Manison, I'll return to the spaceship and wait for you."

Manison's mechanical body nodded, and Mona left the room, following Philip's guidance to the dock.

Only Han Xiao and Manison were left in the room, staring at each other.

"Hehe, Your Excellency Black Star, this is the first time we've met, right?" Manison seemed to be smiling, but the synthesized electronic voice did not show the slightest hint of a smile, and it even sounded a little creepy.

With the other party's technology, it was impossible for him not to create an anthropomorphic voice system. Using such a voice was clearly intentional.

"To be exact, this can't be considered a 'meeting'. You've seen my face, but I haven't seen yours yet," Han Xiao said with a raised brow, but he was secretly trying to figure out Manison's intentions.

It was normal for Mechanics to visit each other, but he felt that Manison had other intentions.

"There will be a chance in the future." The mechanical body pointed at its chest and said, "Do you mind if my consciousness descends?"

Han Xiao thought about it and shook his head.

Boom!

The next moment, a surge of energy descended through the Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission channel. The mechanical body trembled, and a dazzling golden electric light burst out. The energy level soared. Manison's [Lord's Descent] had activated.

The mechanical body's movements instantly became much more natural. Manison twisted his neck and said calmly, "This is much more comfortable."

Long-distance communication was like a video chat, but [Lord's Descent] was immersive.

Han Xiao smiled and did not say anything, but he was shocked.

When Manison's [Lord's Descent] was activated, the Mechanical Force released by the mechanical body was extremely powerful. It even made Han Xiao feel pressured. To be able to make another Beyond Grade A feel pressured, the strength of the Mecha Empire was unfathomable.

Among the Beyond Grade As he had seen, only EsGod's aura was comparable to the Mecha Empire's. This was only the mechanical body of the [Lord's Descent] and not Manison's actual body.

I wonder how many levels higher this guy is than me …

Han Xiao thought about it and gestured toward the door.

"Your Excellency Manison, shall we talk somewhere else?"

"Alright, can you take me on a tour of the Black Star Corps?" Manison nodded.

"Sure."

The two of them stood up and left the room together. They chatted while strolling around the army headquarters.

Although they had just met, the two of them had a tacit understanding not to talk about sensitive things. They started from the army headquarters and commented on the technology used by the headquarters.

Han Xiao maintained his quantum network vision at all times and told Philip to keep the system self-checking.

Although the possibility was not high, he was still on guard against Manison's Virtual Intrusion. After all, the name of the Mecha Empire was equivalent to the existence next door. No matter where he went, he would make the owner suspect that he had been cuckolded.

However, Manison did not have such thoughts and only focused on talking about mechanical knowledge. It was as if they were really just talking about technology.

In terms of technology exchange, the Mecha Empire was indeed very powerful. Manison had accumulated knowledge for many years and had even walked at the forefront of technological innovation. Who knew how many mechanical blueprints he had come up with?

In terms of main class standards, Han Xiao was indeed far behind the other party. The other party had not lived for so many years for nothing.

This was the first time he had come into contact with the Mecha Empire. Han Xiao smiled but did not let his guard down. Other than his preconceived notions, he was also worried about the other party's identity.

"By the way, you said that you're going to help me deal with EsGod?"

"EsGod is currently in the Primeval Star River, which is my headquarters. If the Radiant Federation agrees to your request, I should be the one to take action." Manison turned to look at Han Xiao's face. "Of course, I have my own motives."

"What are they?" Han Xiao was curious.

"Firstly, I warned EsGod before not to come to my territory. Secondly … hehe, I hope to get something from you." Manison did not hide his intentions.

Want something from me? Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. What the Mecha Empire wanted was naturally not his machinery but his Universal Treasure. Was it the Evolution Cube or the Spacetime Amber?

However, Manison did not continue speaking and looked to the side. The two of them were currently in a circular corridor. On one side of the corridor were actual combat training rooms. The two of them walked around and arrived at the training area of the base.

"Since you're here, shall we spar?" Manison's tone was emotionless.

"Here?" Han Xiao shook his head. "With our strength, we'll probably flip my headquarters upside down."

"Don't worry, I didn't bring any other mechanical army. I only have this mechanical shell." Manison shrugged. "You can control a mechanical shell as well. Don't overdo it. This way, the commotion will be small, and it won't hurt our relationship."

If that's the case … Han Xiao pondered for a while before nodding.

"Alright."

He did not need to use his main body to fight. If the shell was damaged, he could just repair it. This was very safe. He guessed that Manison wanted to measure his strength through the strength of his Mechanical Force.

He had broken through the Energy Rank limit of 52000. With his Mechanical Force at this level, he would not be easily destroyed. Han Xiao had the confidence to spar.

Furthermore, the carrier of [Lord's Descent] would share most of the main body's abilities. He also wanted to take a look at Manison's attributes through the combat information.

…

Recommended a book called 'Human Immortal Martial Emperor', written by Demonic Qianmo, a beautiful lady.

Introduction: The two immortals of heaven and earth are precious, and the two immortals of gods and ghosts are ethereal. In my life, I only seek to suppress the heavens with martial arts and become the ruler of the world!
